summary: Frontend testing completed for Burger King-style category tile design on Admin Categories page. All design requirements verified and working correctly.

design_issues.issue: Broken image - shows alt text 'Updated Test Category' instead of actual image
design_issues.note: Pre-existing issue from previous iteration, not related to current design changes

passed_tests: Category tiles display without card borders (border: 0px none)
Category tiles display without box shadows (boxShadow: none)
Category tiles have transparent background (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))
Category images use object-fit: contain
Category images have drop-shadow effect (drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px 8px 16px))
Category images constrained to 85% max-width/height for floating effect
Category names display below image in bold text (fontWeight: 600)
Category names use category's brand color (verified: red, orange, purple, green colors)
Category names are uppercase (textTransform: uppercase)
Hover effect scales tile to 1.03 (transform: scale(1.03))
Hover effect does NOT add shadows (clean scale only)
Image scales to 1.08 on hover for subtle zoom effect
Edit/Deactivate overlay appears on hover (opacity: 0 -> 1)
Overlay covers image area only (bottom: 40px leaves footer visible)
Overlay has rounded corners (borderRadius: 16px)
Edit button visible and clickable on hover
Deactivate button visible and clickable on hover
Live/Off badges visible in corner (7 badges found)
Sort order display removed (0 visible elements)
Clean minimal aesthetic achieved - no boxes around tiles
context_for_next_testing_agent: Burger King-style category tile design verified. All tiles now have clean look without borders/shadows, images float with drop-shadow, category names use brand colors. One pre-existing issue: 'UPDATED TEST CATEGORY' has broken image URL.
